Joel Gillman, co-founder and Vice President of Engineering Operations, was splitting his time between growing the company and managing all of the day-to-day operations of Goldbelly’s technology program.
Co-founder + Vice President
Co-founder + Vice President of Engineering Ops
Removing the stress from a shortened hiring cycle

Like most companies going through periods of scale, Goldbelly needed to quickly hire additional resources to help meet the demands of their growing business. This meant purchasing a lot of devices — and fast.

To expedite the procurement and warehousing of devices for their growing teams, Goldbelly turned to Interlaced's premium asset management. Instead of relying on Apple and being held to their wait times, new employees receive a device ahead of their start date, set up with all the necessary applications for their job.

Likewise, when devices are returned or positions are awaiting fill, those devices are wiped and warehoused by the Interlaced team until they're provisioned for a new user — and Joel and his executive team can see all devices available at any given time.
Since the start of our partnership in 2020, Goldbelly significantly increased their employee base, which originally began with 80 employees working to provide amazing products to their customers.
64% Decrease in Onboarding Time

Originally, Goldbelly was waiting up to four weeks for new employee devices to arrive. Because Interlaced is an authorized Apple Reseller with access to select “Build to Order” devices, these can be purchased and shipped in as little as five days, shortening the onboarding cycle to 10 days or less.
From Reactive to Proactive
Prior to the network rebuild, the Goldbelly team was submitting reports of network slowness. Following the rebuild, the only requests submitted are for proactive maintenance.
